verses.text: For the choir director. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD. Transgression speaks to the ungodly within his heart; There is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.textZh: （耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。）惡人的罪過在他心裡說：我眼中不怕神！

verses.text: For it flatters him in his [own] eyes Concerning the discovery of his iniquity [and] the hatred [of it].
verses.textZh: 他自誇自媚，以為他的罪孽終不顯露，不被恨惡。

verses.text: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit; He has ceased to be wise [and] to do good.
verses.textZh: 他口中的言語盡是罪孽詭詐；他與智慧善行已經斷絕。

verses.text: He plans wickedness upon his bed; He sets himself on a path that is not good; He does not despise evil.
verses.textZh: 他在床上圖謀罪孽，定意行不善的道，不憎惡惡事。

verses.text: Your lovingkindness, O LORD, extends to the heavens, Your faithfulness [reaches] to the skies.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛上及諸天；你的信實達到穹蒼。

verses.text: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; Your judgments are [like] a great deep. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
verses.textZh: 你的公義好像高山；你的判斷如同深淵。耶和華啊，人民、牲畜，你都救護。

verses.text: How precious is Your lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
verses.textZh: 神啊，你的慈愛何其寶貴！世人投靠在你翅膀的蔭下。

verses.text: They drink their fill of the abundance of Your house; And You give them to drink of the river of Your delights.
verses.textZh: 他們必因你殿裡的肥甘得以飽足；你也必叫他們喝你樂河的水。

verses.text: For with You is the fountain of life; In Your light we see light.
verses.textZh: 因為，在你那裡有生命的源頭；在你的光中，我們必得見光。

verses.text: O continue Your lovingkindness to those who know You, And Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.textZh: 願你常施慈愛給認識你的人，常以公義待心裡正直的人。

verses.text: Let not the foot of pride come upon me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.textZh: 不容驕傲人的腳踐踏我；不容凶惡人的手趕逐我。

verses.text: There the doers of iniquity have fallen; They have been thrust down and cannot rise.
verses.textZh: 在那裡，作孽的人已經仆倒；他們被推倒，不能再起來。
